Section III

Crimes against public health and against the environment (Title supplemented - SG, issue 26 of 2004)
Art. 349. (1) Whoever intentionally places or mixes a substance dangerous to life or health in a well, spring, water supply system or in another facility intended for common use, from which or with which drinking water is drawn, shall be punished by deprivation of liberty from two to eight years.
(2) (Supplemented - SG, issue 50 of 1995, amended - SG, issue 153 of 1998) If the act has resulted in serious bodily injury, the punishment shall be deprivation of liberty from three to ten years, and if death has resulted, the punishment shall be deprivation of liberty from ten to twenty years, life imprisonment or life imprisonment without commutation.
(3) (Amended - SG, issue 41 of 1985) In accordance with the differences in the preceding paragraphs, the person who, with the purpose of infecting people, spreads causative agents of an epidemic disease shall also be punished.
Art. 349a. (New - SG, issue 62 of 1997) (1) Whoever violates rules established for the taking and provision of human organs or tissues for transplantation shall be punished by deprivation of liberty from one to three years.
(2) The punishment shall be deprivation of liberty from three to five years if the act has been committed for gain.
Art. 350. (Amended - SG, issue 26 of 2004) (1) Whoever prepares food or beverages intended for common use in such a manner that substances dangerous to health are created in them or enter them, as well as the person who sells, offers for sale or otherwise puts into circulation such food or beverages, shall be punished by deprivation of liberty up to five years.
(2) Whoever violates rules regulating the extraction, production, processing, storage or trade of animals, raw materials, food or beverages intended for common use, and thereby endangers the health or life of another, shall be punished by deprivation of liberty up to three years.
(3) If the act under para. 1 and 2 has resulted in medium bodily injury to another - the punishment shall be deprivation of liberty up to six years, if serious bodily injury to another has resulted - deprivation of liberty from one to eight years, and if death has resulted - deprivation of liberty from three to fifteen years.
Art. 350a. (New - SG, issue 26 of 2004) Whoever in violation of the law produces or places on the market food, animal feed or veterinary medicinal products, or beverages, and thereby endangers the life or health of another, shall be punished by deprivation of liberty up to three years.
Art. 351. (1) (Amended - SG, issue 103 of 2004, effective from 01.01.2005) For acts under Art. 349 and 350, committed by negligence, the punishment shall be deprivation of liberty up to two years or probation.
(2) If in this case death has resulted for someone, the punishment shall be deprivation of liberty up to five years.
Art. 352. (1) (Amended - SG, issue 95 of 1975, amended - SG, issue 86 of 1991, amended - SG, issue 85 of 1997, amended - SG, issue 26 of 2004, amended - SG, issue 33 of 2011, effective from 27.05.2011) Whoever pollutes or allows to be polluted the soil, air, water streams, basins, underground waters, territorial or internal sea waters or sea waters in zones defined by an international agreement in which the Republic of Bulgaria participates, and thereby makes them dangerous for people or animals and plants or unfit for their use for cultural-domestic, health, agricultural and other economic purposes, shall be punished by deprivation of liberty from one to five years and a fine from five thousand to thirty thousand leva.
(2) (Amended - SG, issue 26 of 2004) The same punishment shall be imposed on an official who has allowed, in the design, construction or operation of drainage or irrigation systems, the failure to take the necessary measures to prevent dangerous pollution of the water-bearing zones for drinking water supply or the raising of the level of underground waters in populated and resort areas.
(3) (Amended - SG, issue 10 of 1993, amended - SG, issue 92 of 2002, amended - SG, issue 103 of 2004, effective from 01.01.2005, amended - SG, issue 33 of 2011, effective from 27.05.2011) When the acts under para. 1 or 2 have caused:
1. death or serious bodily injury to one or more persons, the punishment shall be deprivation of liberty from five to twenty years and a fine from ten thousand to fifty thousand leva;
2. significant harm to the environment, the punishment shall be deprivation of liberty from two to eight years and a fine from ten thousand to fifty thousand leva.
(4) (New - SG, issue 95 of 1975, amended - SG, issue 28 of 1982, effective from 01.07.1982, amended - SG, issue 10 of 1993, amended - SG, issue 92 of 2002, amended - SG, issue 33 of 2011, effective from 27.05.2011) If the act under para. 1 or 2 has been committed by negligence, the punishment shall be deprivation of liberty up to three years and a fine from two thousand to twenty thousand leva.
Art. 352a. (New - SG, issue 95 of 1975, amended - SG, issue 86 of 1991) (1) (Amended - SG, issue 85 of 1997, amended and supplemented - SG, issue 33 of 2011, effective from 27.05.2011) Whoever pollutes or allows to be polluted with petroleum products or derivatives territorial or internal sea waters or sea waters in zones defined by an international agreement in which the Republic of Bulgaria participates, shall be punished by deprivation of liberty from one to six years and a fine from ten thousand to fifty thousand leva. When the act has been committed by a ship captain, the court shall also order deprivation of the right under Art. 37, para. 1, item 7.
(2) (Amended - SG, issue 10 of 1993, amended - SG, issue 33 of 2011, effective from 27.05.2011) The punishment under para. 1 shall also be imposed on the person who pollutes or allows to be polluted the waters under para. 1 with harmful liquid substances in bulk, defined in an international agreement in which the Republic of Bulgaria participates.
(3) (Amended - SG, issue 28 of 1982, effective from 01.07.1982, amended - SG, issue 10 of 1993, amended - SG, issue 92 of 2002, amended - SG, issue 33 of 2011, effective from 27.05.2011) When the act under para. 1 or 2 has been committed by negligence, the punishment shall be deprivation of liberty up to three years and a fine from two thousand to fifteen thousand leva.
(4) (Amended - SG, issue 10 of 1993) A ship captain or other vessel captain who does not immediately report to the nearest port the discharge into waters referred to in para. 1 of petroleum products or derivatives, or other substances dangerous to people, animals or plants, shall be punished by a fine up to five hundred leva.
(5) (Amended - SG, issue 28 of 1982, effective from 01.07.1982, amended - SG, issue 10 of 1993, amended - SG, issue 92 of 2002) A captain or other person from the command staff of a ship who fails to fulfill the obligation to record in the ship's documents an operation with substances dangerous to people, animals or plants, or enters false information in them about such operations, or refuses to present these documents to the relevant officials, shall be punished by a fine from one hundred to three hundred leva, imposed by administrative procedure.
Art. 353. (1) (Amended - SG, issue 95 of 1975, amended - SG, issue 86 of 1991, amended - SG, issue 92 of 2002) An official who puts into operation or orders to be put into operation an enterprise or thermal power plant before the necessary purification facilities have been put into operation, shall be punished by deprivation of liberty up to three years and a fine from one hundred to three hundred leva.
(2) The same punishment shall be imposed on an official who fails to fulfill his obligations for the construction of purification facilities, as well as for ensuring the serviceability and continuous proper operation of such facilities, as a result of which they could not enter into operation fully or partially or have ceased their operation.
(3) (Amended - SG, issue 10 of 1993, amended - SG, issue 92 of 2002, amended - SG, issue 103 of 2004, effective from 01.01.2005) If the act under the preceding paragraphs has been committed by negligence, the punishment shall be probation or a fine from one hundred to three hundred leva.
(4) (New - SG, issue 95 of 1975, amended - SG, issue 28 of 1982, effective from 01.07.1982, amended - SG, issue 10 of 1993, amended - SG, issue 92 of 2002) In minor cases, the punishment shall be: under para. 1 and 2 - a fine from one hundred to three hundred leva, and under para. 3 - a fine from one hundred to three hundred leva, imposed by administrative procedure.
Art. 353a. (New - SG, issue 86 of 1991, amended - SG, issue 85 of 1997) An official who, within the scope of his official duties, conceals or discloses false information about the state of the environment and its components - air, water, soil, marine spaces - and this results in significant harm to the environment, life and human health, shall be punished by deprivation of liberty up to five years and a fine from one hundred to one thousand leva.
Art. 353b. (New - SG, issue 62 of 1997, supplemented - SG, issue 92 of 2002, amended - SG, issue 33 of 2011, effective from 27.05.2011) (1) Whoever manages waste not in the established manner and thereby creates danger to the life or health of another or for causing significant harm to the environment, shall be punished by deprivation of liberty from one to five years and a fine from five thousand to thirty thousand leva.
(2) When the act under para. 1 has caused:
1. death or serious bodily injury to one or more persons, the punishment shall be deprivation of liberty from five to twenty years and a fine from ten thousand to fifty thousand leva;
2. significant harm to the environment, the punishment shall be deprivation of liberty from two to eight years and a fine from ten thousand to fifty thousand leva.
(3) Whoever violates or fails to fulfill his obligations to ensure the serviceability and proper functioning of an installation or facility for the disposal or recovery of waste and thereby causes death or serious bodily injury to one or more persons, shall be punished by deprivation of liberty from five to twenty years and a fine from ten thousand to fifty thousand leva, and if significant harm to the environment has been caused, the punishment shall be deprivation of liberty from two to eight years and a fine from ten thousand to fifty thousand leva.
(4) When the acts under para. 1 - 3 have been committed by negligence, the punishment shall be deprivation of liberty up to three years and a fine from two thousand to fifteen thousand leva.
Art. 353c. (New - SG, issue 62 of 1997, amended - SG, issue 33 of 2011, effective from 27.05.2011) (1) Whoever manages hazardous waste not in the established manner, shall be punished by deprivation of liberty up to five years and a fine from two thousand to twenty thousand leva.
(2) When the act under para. 1 creates danger to the life or health of another or for causing significant harm to the environment, the punishment shall be deprivation of liberty from one to six years and a fine from ten thousand to thirty thousand leva.
(3) When the act under para. 1 has caused death or serious bodily injury to one or more persons, the punishment shall be deprivation of liberty from ten to twenty years and a fine from fifteen thousand to fifty thousand leva, and if significant harm to the environment has been caused, the punishment shall be deprivation of liberty from three to ten years and a fine from twenty thousand to fifty thousand leva.
(4) An official who violates or fails to fulfill his obligations for the management of hazardous waste shall be punished by deprivation of liberty up to three years.
(5) When the acts under para. 1 - 3 have been committed by negligence, the punishment shall be deprivation of liberty up to three years and a fine from three thousand to twenty thousand leva.
Art. 353d. (New - SG, issue 33 of 2011, effective from 27.05.2011) (1) Whoever in violation of the established procedure transports waste across the border of the country, when the act committed does not constitute a minor case, shall be punished by deprivation of liberty up to four years and a fine from two thousand to five thousand leva.
(2) Whoever in violation of international treaties to which the Republic of Bulgaria is a party, transports across the border of the country hazardous waste, toxic chemical substances, biological agents, toxins and radioactive substances, shall be punished by deprivation of liberty from one to five years and a fine from five thousand to twenty thousand leva.
(3) When the acts under para. 1 or 2 have been committed by negligence, the punishment shall be deprivation of liberty up to two years or probation.
Art. 353e. (New - SG, issue 33 of 2011, effective from 27.05.2011) (1) Whoever stores not in the established manner hazardous substances or mixtures and thereby creates danger to the life or health of another or for causing significant harm to the environment, shall be punished by deprivation of liberty up to four years and a fine from two thousand to five thousand leva.
(2) Whoever not in the established manner puts into operation or orders to be put into operation an enterprise or installation for the functioning of which hazardous substances or mixtures are used, and thereby creates danger to the life or health of another or for causing significant harm to the environment, shall be punished by deprivation of liberty from one to five years and a fine from five thousand to twenty thousand leva.
(3) The punishment under para. 2 shall also be imposed on the person who not in the established manner puts into operation or orders to be put into operation an enterprise or installation whose functioning may create danger to the life or health of another or for causing significant harm to the environment.
(4) If in the cases under para. 2 and 3 death or serious bodily injury to one or more persons has been caused, the punishment shall be deprivation of liberty from eight to fifteen years and a fine from ten thousand to thirty thousand leva, and if significant harm to the environment has been caused, the punishment shall be deprivation of liberty from two to eight years and a fine from fifteen thousand to thirty thousand leva.
(5) When the acts under para. 1 - 4 have been committed by negligence, the punishment shall be deprivation of liberty up to two years or probation.
Art. 353f. (New - SG, issue 33 of 2011, effective from 27.05.2011) (1) Whoever in violation of the established procedure produces, uses, distributes, imports or exports across the border of the country substances that damage the ozone layer, shall be punished by deprivation of liberty up to four years and a fine from one thousand to five thousand leva.
(2) When the act under para. 1 has been committed by negligence, the punishment shall be deprivation of liberty up to one year or probation.
Art. 353g. (New - SG, issue 26 of 2004, previous Art. 353d - SG, issue 33 of 2011, effective from 27.05.2011) Whoever in violation of the law constructs a water intake facility or facility for the use of surface or underground waters, shall be punished by deprivation of liberty up to two years and a fine from five thousand to fifteen thousand leva.
Art. 353h. (New - SG, issue 26 of 2004, previous Art. 353e - SG, issue 33 of 2011, effective from 27.05.2011) Whoever in violation of the law uses mineral water for economic activity, shall be punished by deprivation of liberty up to one year and a fine up to five thousand leva.
Art. 354. (1) (Amended - SG, issue 95 of 1975, amended - SG, issue 28 of 1982, effective from 01.07.1982, amended - SG, issue 10 of 1993, amended - SG, issue 92 of 2002, supplemented - SG, issue 75 of 2006, effective from 13.10.2006) Whoever without proper authorization produces, acquires, possesses, alienates or transfers to another a strongly acting or poisonous substance that is not a narcotic substance placed under a permit regime, shall be punished by deprivation of liberty up to two years or a fine from one hundred to three hundred leva.
(2) (Amended - SG, issue 10 of 1993, amended - SG, issue 92 of 2002, amended - SG, issue 75 of 2006, effective from 13.10.2006) If the crime under para. 1 is committed systematically, the punishment shall be deprivation of liberty up to three years and a fine from one hundred to three hundred leva.
(3) The object of the crime shall be confiscated in favor of the state.
(4) (New - SG, issue 95 of 1975, amended - SG, issue 10 of 1993, amended - SG, issue 92 of 2002, amended - SG, issue 103 of 2004, effective from 01.01.2005) Whoever violates rules established for the production, acquisition, storage, accounting, dispensing, transportation or carrying of substances under para. 1, shall be punished by deprivation of liberty up to two years or probation or a fine from one hundred to three hundred leva.
Art. 354a. (New - SG, issue 95 of 1975, amended - SG, issue 75 of 2006, effective from 13.10.2006) (1) Whoever without proper authorization produces, processes, acquires or possesses narcotic substances or their analogues with the purpose of distribution, or distributes narcotic substances or their analogues, shall be punished for high-risk narcotic substances or their analogues - by deprivation of liberty from two to eight years and a fine from five thousand to twenty thousand leva, and for risky narcotic substances or their analogues - by deprivation of liberty from one to six years and a fine from two thousand to ten thousand leva. When the object of the crime is precursors or equipment or materials for the production of narcotic substances or their analogues, the punishment shall be deprivation of liberty from three to twelve years and a fine from twenty thousand to one hundred thousand leva.
(2) (Amended - SG, issue 26 of 2010) When the narcotic substances or their analogues are in large quantities, the punishment shall be deprivation of liberty from three to twelve years and a fine from ten thousand to fifty thousand leva. Whoever without proper authorization in a public place acquires or possesses with the purpose of distribution, or distributes narcotic substances or their analogues, as well as when the narcotic substances or their analogues are in particularly large quantities or the act has been committed:
1. by a person who acts on the order or in execution of a decision of an organized criminal group;
2. by a doctor or pharmacist;
3. by an educator, teacher, head of an educational institution or official at or on the occasion of the performance of his service;
4. under the conditions of dangerous recidivism,
the punishment shall be deprivation of liberty from five to fifteen years and a fine from twenty thousand to one hundred thousand leva.
(3) Whoever without proper authorization acquires or possesses narcotic substances or their analogues, shall be punished:
1. for high-risk narcotic substances or their analogues - by deprivation of liberty from one to six years and a fine from two thousand to ten thousand leva;
2. for risky narcotic substances or their analogues - by deprivation of liberty up to five years and a fine from one thousand to five thousand leva.
(4) Whoever violates rules established for the production, acquisition, storage, accounting, dispensing, transportation or carrying of narcotic substances, shall be punished by deprivation of liberty up to five years and a fine up to five thousand leva, and the court may also order deprivation of the rights under Art. 37, para. 1, items 6 and 7.
(5) In minor cases under para. 3 and 4, the punishment shall be a fine up to one thousand leva.
(6) In the cases under para. 1 - 5, the object and means of the crime shall be confiscated in favor of the state.
Art. 354b. (New - SG, issue 95 of 1975) (1) (Amended - SG, issue 62 of 1997, amended - SG, issue 21 of 2000, amended - SG, issue 75 of 2006, effective from 13.10.2006) Whoever induces or assists another to use narcotic substances or their analogues, shall be punished by deprivation of liberty from one to eight years and a fine from five thousand to ten thousand leva.
(2) (Amended - SG, issue 21 of 2000) When the act under para. 1 has been committed:
1. with respect to a minor, juvenile or insane person;
2. with respect to more than two persons;
3. (supplemented - SG, issue 75 of 2006, effective from 13.10.2006) by a doctor, pharmacist, educator, teacher, head of an educational institution or official in places of deprivation of liberty at or on the occasion of the performance of his service;
4. (amended - SG, issue 75 of 2006, effective from 13.10.2006) in a public place;
5. (amended - SG, issue 75 of 2006, effective from 13.10.2006, amended - SG, issue 67 of 2023) through the mass media;
6. (amended - SG, issue 75 of 2006, effective from 13.10.2006) under the conditions of dangerous recidivism,
the punishment shall be deprivation of liberty from three to ten years and a fine from twenty thousand to fifty thousand leva, and the court in the cases of item 3 shall order deprivation of the rights under Art. 37, para. 1, items 6 and 7.
(3) (New - SG, issue 21 of 2000, amended - SG, issue 75 of 2006, effective from 13.10.2006) Whoever gives to another a narcotic substance or its analogue in quantities that may cause death and such results, shall be punished by deprivation of liberty from fifteen to twenty years and a fine from one hundred thousand to three hundred thousand leva.
(4) (Amended - SG, issue 10 of 1993, amended - SG, issue 62 of 1997, previous para. 3 - SG, issue 21 of 2000, amended - SG, issue 75 of 2006, effective from 13.10.2006) Whoever systematically provides premises to different persons for the use of narcotic substances or organizes the use of such substances, shall be punished by deprivation of liberty from one to ten years and a fine from five thousand to twenty thousand leva.
(5) (Amended - SG, issue 10 of 1993, amended - SG, issue 62 of 1997, previous para. 4 - SG, issue 21 of 2000, amended - SG, issue 75 of 2006, effective from 13.10.2006) A doctor who in violation of the established procedure knowingly prescribes to another narcotic substances or their analogues or medicines that contain such substances, shall be punished by deprivation of liberty up to five years and a fine up to three thousand leva, and the court may order deprivation of the rights under Art. 37, para. 1, items 6 and 7.
(6) (Previous para. 5 - SG, issue 21 of 2000, amended - SG, issue 26 of 2004) If the act under the preceding paragraph has been committed repeatedly, the punishment shall be deprivation of liberty from one to six years, a fine up to five thousand leva and deprivation of the rights under Art. 37, para. 1, items 6 and 7.
Art. 354c. (New - SG, issue 95 of 1975, amended - SG, issue 62 of 1997, amended - SG, issue 21 of 2000) (1) (Amended - SG, issue 75 of 2006, effective from 13.10.2006) Whoever sows or cultivates plants of opium poppy and coca bush or plants of the genus cannabis in violation of the rules established in the Law on Control of Narcotic Substances and Precursors, shall be punished by deprivation of liberty from two to five years and a fine from five thousand to ten thousand leva.
(2) (Amended - SG, issue 75 of 2006, effective from 13.10.2006) Whoever organizes, leads or finances an organized criminal group for the cultivation of plants under para. 1 or for the extraction, production or processing of narcotic substances, shall be punished by deprivation of liberty from ten to twenty years and a fine from fifty thousand to two hundred thousand leva.
(3) (Supplemented - SG, issue 75 of 2006, effective from 13.10.2006) Whoever participates in an organized criminal group under the preceding paragraph, shall be punished by deprivation of liberty from three to ten years and a fine from five thousand to ten thousand leva.
(4) (Supplemented - SG, issue 75 of 2006, effective from 13.10.2006) A participant in an organized criminal group who has voluntarily reported to the authorities all facts and circumstances known to him about the activity of the criminal group shall not be punished.
(5) In minor cases under para. 1, the punishment shall be deprivation of liberty up to one year and a fine up to one thousand leva.
Art. 355. (1) (Amended - SG, issue 28 of 1982, amended - SG, issue 10 of 1993, amended - SG, issue 92 of 2002, amended - SG, issue 103 of 2004, effective from 01.01.2005, amended and supplemented - SG, issue 23 of 2020, amended - SG, issue 28 of 2020, effective from 24.03.2020) Whoever violates an ordinance, rules or measures issued against the spread or occurrence of a contagious disease in humans, shall be punished by deprivation of liberty up to three years and a fine from one thousand to ten thousand leva.
(2) (Amended - SG, issue 103 of 2004, effective from 01.01.2005, amended - SG, issue 23 of 2020) If the act has been committed during an epidemic, pandemic or state of emergency related to deaths, the punishment shall be deprivation of liberty up to five years and a fine from ten to fifty thousand leva.
(3) (Amended - SG, issue 28 of 1982, amended - SG, issue 10 of 1993, amended - SG, issue 92 of 2002, amended - SG, issue 103 of 2004, effective from 01.01.2005) Whoever violates an ordinance issued for the prevention of food poisoning, shall be punished by probation or a fine from one hundred to three hundred leva.
Art. 356. (1) Whoever violates the established construction, sanitary or fire safety rules in the design, management or execution of construction works and thereby endangers the life of another, shall be punished by deprivation of liberty up to two years.
(2) (Amended - SG, issue 103 of 2004, effective from 01.01.2005) If the violation of the rules under the preceding paragraph has been committed by negligence, the punishment shall be deprivation of liberty up to one year or probation.

heading: Раздел IV
text:
Раздел IV

Други общоопасни престъпления (Нов - ДВ, бр. 41 от 1985 г.)
Чл. 356а. (Нов - ДВ, бр. 41 от 1985 г., изм. - ДВ, бр. 21 от 2000 г., доп. - ДВ, бр. 26 от 2004 г., изм. - ДВ, бр. 33 от 2011 г., в сила от 27.05.2011 г.) За приготовление към престъпление по чл. 330, 333, 334, 340, 341а, 341б, чл. 342, ал. 3, чл. 344, 349, 350, чл. 352, ал. 1, чл. 353ж, 353з, чл. 354, 354а и 354в, ако извършеното не съставлява по-тежко престъпление, наказанието е лишаване от свобода от три до осем години, но не повече от наказанието, предвидено за съответното престъпление.
Чл. 356б. (Нов - ДВ, бр. 41 от 1985 г.) (1) Чужд гражданин, който на територията на републиката се подготвя да извърши в чужбина деяние по чл. 242, ал. 2 и 3 или някое от деянията, посочени в чл. 356а, се наказва с лишаване от свобода до пет години, но не повече от наказанието, предвидено за съответното престъпление.
(2) Ако със същата цел е създадена организация или група, наказанието е лишаване от свобода от една до шест години, а за организаторите и ръководителите - лишаване от свобода от три до осем години, но не повече от наказанието, предвидено за съответното престъпление.
Чл. 356в. (Нов - ДВ, бр. 41 от 1985 г., отм. - ДВ, бр. 21 от 2000 г.)

Раздел IV

Other Generally Dangerous Crimes (New - SG, issue 41 of 1985)
Art. 356a. (New - SG, issue 41 of 1985, amend. - SG, issue 21 of 2000, suppl. - SG, issue 26 of 2004, amend. - SG, issue 33 of 2011, effective from 27.05.2011) For preparation for a crime under Art. 330, 333, 334, 340, 341a, 341b, Art. 342, para. 3, Art. 344, 349, 350, Art. 352, para. 1, Art. 353zh, 353z, Art. 354, 354a and 354v, if the act committed does not constitute a more serious crime, the punishment shall be imprisonment from three to eight years, but not more than the punishment provided for the respective crime.
Art. 356b. (New - SG, issue 41 of 1985) (1) A foreign citizen who on the territory of the republic prepares to commit abroad an act under Art. 242, para. 2 and 3 or any of the acts specified in Art. 356a, shall be punished by imprisonment of up to five years, but not more than the punishment provided for the respective crime.
(2) If an organization or group has been created for the same purpose, the punishment shall be imprisonment from one to six years, and for the organizers and leaders - imprisonment from three to eight years, but not more than the punishment provided for the respective crime.
Art. 356v. (New - SG, issue 41 of 1985, repealed - SG, issue 21 of 2000)

heading: Section V
Раздел I
text:
Раздел I

Престъпления против информацията, представляваща държавна тайна, и против чуждестранната класифицирана информация (Загл. изм. - ДВ, бр. 26 от 2004 г.)
Чл. 357. (1) (Зал., предишна ал. 2, изм. - ДВ, бр. 95 от 1975 г., изм. - ДВ, бр. 26 от 2004 г., изм. - ДВ, бр. 26 от 2010 г.) Който разгласи информация, представляваща държавна тайна, която му е била поверена или станала известна по служба или работа, както и този, който разгласи такава информация, като съзнава, че от това може да последват вреди за интересите на Република България, ако не подлежи на по-тежко наказание, се наказва с лишаване от свобода от две до осем години.
(2) (Предишна ал. 3 - ДВ, бр. 95 от 1975 г., изм. - ДВ, бр. 26 от 2010 г.) Ако от деянието са настъпили или могат да настъпят особено тежки последици за сигурността на държавата, наказанието е лишаване от свобода от пет до петнадесет години.
(3) (Нова - ДВ, бр. 26 от 2004 г.) С наказанието по ал. 1 и 2 се наказва и този, който разгласи чуждестранна класифицирана информация, получена по международен договор, по който Република България е страна.
Чл. 357а. (Нов - ДВ, бр. 10 от 1993 г., отм. - ДВ, бр. 26 от 2004 г.)
Чл. 357б. (Нов - ДВ, бр. 41 от 2001 г., отм. - ДВ, бр. 26 от 2004 г.)
Чл. 358. (1) (Изм. - ДВ, бр. 26 от 2004 г., изм. - ДВ, бр. 103 от 2004 г., в сила от 01.01.2005 г.) Който загуби документи, издания или материали, съдържащи информация, представляваща държавна тайна, или чуждестранна класифицирана информация, получена по международен договор, по който Република България е страна, се наказва с лишаване от свобода до две години или с пробация.
(2) Ако от деянието са настъпили или могат да настъпят особено тежки последици, наказанието е лишаване от свобода до пет години.
Чл. 359. (1) (Изм. - ДВ, бр. 26 от 2004 г., изм. - ДВ, бр. 103 от 2004 г., в сила от 01.01.2005 г.) Който стане причина да бъде разкрита информация, представляваща държавна тайна, или чуждестранна класифицирана информация, получена по международен договор, по който Република България е страна по непредпазливост, се наказва с лишаване от свобода до две години или с пробация.
(2) (Изм. - ДВ, бр. 26 от 2004 г.) Ако това е станало поради неспазване на нормативно установените изисквания за защита на класифицирана информация, наказанието е лишаване от свобода до три години.
Чл. 360. (Изм. - ДВ, бр. 103 от 2004 г., в сила от 01.01.2005 г.) Който разгласи сведения от военно, стопанско или друго естество, които не са държавна тайна, но чието разгласяване е забранено със закон, заповед или друго административно разпореждане, се наказва с лишаване от свобода до една година или пробация.
translated_text:
Раздел I

Crimes against information constituting a state secret and against foreign classified information (Heading amended - SG, issue 26 of 2004)
Art. 357. (1) (Repealed, former para. 2, amended - SG, issue 95 of 1975, amended - SG, issue 26 of 2004, amended - SG, issue 26 of 2010) Whoever discloses information constituting a state secret which has been entrusted to him or became known to him by service or work, as well as whoever discloses such information, being aware that harm to the interests of the Republic of Bulgaria may result therefrom, if not subject to a more severe punishment, shall be punished by deprivation of liberty from two to eight years.
(2) (Former para. 3 - SG, issue 95 of 1975, amended - SG, issue 26 of 2010) If particularly severe consequences for the security of the state have occurred or may occur from the act, the punishment shall be deprivation of liberty from five to fifteen years.
(3) (New - SG, issue 26 of 2004) The punishment under para. 1 and 2 shall also be imposed on whoever discloses foreign classified information received under an international treaty to which the Republic of Bulgaria is a party.
Art. 357a. (New - SG, issue 10 of 1993, repealed - SG, issue 26 of 2004)
Art. 357b. (New - SG, issue 41 of 2001, repealed - SG, issue 26 of 2004)
Art. 358. (1) (Amended - SG, issue 26 of 2004, amended - SG, issue 103 of 2004, effective from 01.01.2005) Whoever loses documents, publications or materials containing information constituting a state secret, or foreign classified information received under an international treaty to which the Republic of Bulgaria is a party, shall be punished by deprivation of liberty up to two years or by probation.
(2) If particularly severe consequences have occurred or may occur from the act, the punishment shall be deprivation of liberty up to five years.
Art. 359. (1) (Amended - SG, issue 26 of 2004, amended - SG, issue 103 of 2004, effective from 01.01.2005) Whoever causes information constituting a state secret, or foreign classified information received under an international treaty to which the Republic of Bulgaria is a party, to be disclosed through negligence, shall be punished by deprivation of liberty up to two years or by probation.
(2) (Amended - SG, issue 26 of 2004) If this has occurred due to non-compliance with the normatively established requirements for protection of classified information, the punishment shall be deprivation of liberty up to three years.
Art. 360. (Amended - SG, issue 103 of 2004, effective from 01.01.2005) Whoever discloses information of a military, economic or other nature which is not a state secret, but whose disclosure is prohibited by law, order or other administrative instruction, shall be punished by deprivation of liberty up to one year or probation.

heading: Раздел II
text:
Раздел II

Престъпления против носене на военната служба
Чл. 361. (1) (Отм. - ДВ, бр. 38 от 2007 г., в сила от 01.12.2007 г., изм. относно влизането в сила - ДВ, бр. 89 от 2007 г.)
(2) (Изм. - ДВ, бр. 103 от 2004 г., в сила от 01.01.2005 г., изм. - ДВ, бр. 75 от 2006 г., в сила от 13.10.2006 г., отм. - ДВ, бр. 20 от 2012 г., в сила от 10.06.2012 г.)
Чл. 362. (Отм. - ДВ, бр. 38 от 2007 г., в сила от 01.12.2007 г., изм. относно влизането в сила - ДВ, бр. 89 от 2007 г.)
Чл. 363. (Отм. - ДВ, бр. 38 от 2007 г., в сила от 01.12.2007 г., изм. относно влизането в сила - ДВ, бр. 89 от 2007 г.)
Чл. 364. (1) Който при мобилизация се отклони от военна служба, се наказва с лишаване от свобода от една до пет години.
(2) (Отм. - ДВ, бр. 38 от 2007 г., в сила от 01.12.2007 г., изм. относно влизането в сила - ДВ, бр. 89 от 2007 г.)
(3) (Изм. - ДВ, бр. 153 от 1998 г., изм. - ДВ, бр. 38 от 2007 г., в сила от 01.12.2007 г., изм. относно влизането в сила - ДВ, бр. 89 от 2007 г.) Ако деянието по ал. 1 е извършено във военно време, наказанието е лишаване от свобода от пет до двадесет години или доживотен затвор без замяна.
Чл. 365. (Изм. - ДВ, бр. 103 от 2004 г., в сила от 01.01.2005 г., отм. - ДВ, бр. 38 от 2007 г., в сила от 01.12.2007 г., изм. относно влизането в сила - ДВ, бр. 89 от 2007 г.)
Чл. 366. (Изм. - ДВ, бр. 28 от 1982 г., в сила от 01.07.1982 г., изм. - ДВ, бр. 10 от 1993 г., изм. - ДВ, бр. 92 от 2002 г., изм. - ДВ, бр. 20 от 2012 г., в сила от 10.06.2012 г.) Който наруши задълженията си по военния отчет на българските граждани и техниката извън случаите, предвидени в специалните закони за военния отчет, се наказва с лишаване от свобода до две години и с глоба от сто до триста лева, ако извършеното не съставлява по-тежко престъпление, а във военно време - с лишаване от свобода от три до десет години и с глоба от сто до триста лева.
Чл. 367. (1) Който не изпълнява разпорежданията, свързани с подготовката и провеждането на мобилизация, или пречи на нейното нормално провеждане, се наказва с лишаване от свобода от една до осем години, а в особено тежки случаи - с лишаване от свобода от пет до петнадесет години.
(2) (Изм. - ДВ, бр. 28 от 1982 г., в сила от 01.07.1982 г., изм. - ДВ, бр. 10 от 1993 г., изм. - ДВ, бр. 92 от 2002 г., изм. - ДВ, бр. 103 от 2004 г., в сила от 01.01.2005 г.) Ако деянието по предходната алинея е извършено по непредпазливост, наказанието е пробация или глоба от сто до триста лева.
Чл. 368. (Изм. - ДВ, бр. 75 от 2006 г., в сила от 13.10.2006 г., изм. - ДВ, бр. 38 от 2007 г., в сила от 01.12.2007 г., изм. и доп. - ДВ, бр. 20 от 2012 г., в сила от 10.06.2012 г.) Който съзнателно наруши задълженията си при медицинско освидетелствуване на военнослужещи, резервисти и запасни, или при преглед на техниката във връзка с военния отчет, се наказва с лишаване от свобода до осем години, а във военно време - с лишаване от свобода от пет до петнадесет години.

Art. 361. (1) (Repealed - SG, issue 38 of 2007, effective from 01.12.2007, amended regarding entry into force - SG, issue 89 of 2007)
(2) (Amended - SG, issue 103 of 2004, effective from 01.01.2005, amended - SG, issue 75 of 2006, effective from 13.10.2006, repealed - SG, issue 20 of 2012, effective from 10.06.2012)

Art. 364. (1) Whoever evades military service during mobilization shall be punished by deprivation of liberty from one to five years.
(2) (Repealed - SG, issue 38 of 2007, effective from 01.12.2007, amended regarding entry into force - SG, issue 89 of 2007)
(3) (Amended - SG, issue 153 of 1998, amended - SG, issue 38 of 2007, effective from 01.12.2007, amended regarding entry into force - SG, issue 89 of 2007) If the act under para. 1 is committed in wartime, the punishment shall be deprivation of liberty from five to twenty years or life imprisonment without substitution.

Art. 366. Art. 367. (1) Whoever fails to comply with orders related to the preparation and conduct of mobilization, or obstructs its normal conduct, shall be punished by deprivation of liberty from one to eight years, and in particularly serious cases - by deprivation of liberty from five to fifteen years.
(2) (Amended - SG, issue 28 of 1982, effective from 01.07.1982, amended - SG, issue 10 of 1993, amended - SG, issue 92 of 2002, amended - SG, issue 103 of 2004, effective from 01.01.2005) If the act under the preceding paragraph is committed through negligence, the punishment shall be probation or a fine from one hundred to three hundred leva.
Art. 368.
